scope.description: Four-member in-memory cluster per case; one explicit LeadershipTransferToServer with no automatic request; leader state and all member terms sampled every 10 ms for five seconds.
assumptions: inmemConfig timeouts (Heartbeat, Election and Lease 50 ms) so an election round is observable within the window.
The demoted member's own configuration view reports the non-voter role before the request is issued.
excluded: Transfers issued concurrently with the demotion or during an election.
Clusters whose only reachable member is the non-voter.

comparisons.description: A transfer that is admitted for a named member must install that member; a false witness shows the request accepted with no leader installed.
The same single-request sequence naming an ordinary voter must install that voter, which separates the request path from the target's eligibility.
If naming an ineligible member cannot install a leader, the cluster should not pay a leaderless interval for the attempt; any leaderless sample attributes the disruption to this request alone.
